title: Materialize provider-neutral external LLM discovery without creating a cloud fallback or routing authority
decisions: External LLM catalogs are discovery and capability-intelligence sources, never model-routing or provider-admission authorities.
The FreeLLM upstream is a replaceable reference source pinned to an observed immutable commit for evidence; its floating main branch may be consulted only as non-authoritative discovery input.
The normalized runtime catalog is generated user/runtime state and must not become canonical physical provider or model policy.
The source parser initializes every provider at DISCOVERED and cannot mark a provider VERIFIED, ADMITTED or ENABLED.

Provider activation requires separate FA3 provider identity, security/privacy/egress admission, credential-handle admission where needed, provider runtime or remote admission evidence, and a live model/capability probe.
The existing FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 remains the only model/provider/runtime routing authority and LiteLLM remains a data plane.
Baseline logical routes remain LOCAL_ONLY with external fallback denied; external/cloud use requires a separately materialized explicit policy.

Decision Fabric may advise ranking only inside the deterministically admitted external-provider set and cannot add candidates, admit providers, authorize egress, obtain credentials or override Model Router.
Provider Explorer is a child surface of Models & Providers and may display discovery metadata or create a DRAFT admission intent only.
No upstream README, API key link or free-tier claim is copied into FA3 as secret material, trust evidence or automatic entitlement.
